planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. Preserved authoritative wiring: LM35->A1, Fan PWM->D5, TM1637 CLK->D4 and DIO->D2, Buzzer->D6.
No explicit serial reporting requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are declared.
No explicit PWM scaling, temperature conversion calibration, or exact speed-threshold values are specified in the requirements; those belong in the SysML model.
Fan speed level to be shown on TM1637 is handled in SysML; device request only exposes the TM1637 numeric port.

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer short鸣提示 for entering high speed

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Display current fan speed level on TM1637

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多级风扇控制系统，使用 LM35（A1）、风扇 PWM D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。根据温度把风扇分为关闭、低速、中速、高速四档，数码管显示当前档位；进入高速档时蜂鸣器短鸣提示。
